rows.Name: Resource Plan_GroupedForDemand
rows.Expression:
let
    Source = #"Resource Plan",
    #"Filtered Rows" = Table.SelectRows(Source, each [Booking Type] = "Proposed"),

    #"Grouped Rows" = Table.Group(
        #"Filtered Rows",
        {
            "ResourceID",
            "Resource Name",
            "DepartmentID",
            "Department Name",
            "ProjectID",
            "Project Name",
            "Resource Plan Date"
        },
        {
            {
                "Forecast Demand",
                each List.Sum([Forecast Demand]),
                type number
            },
            {
                "AtossAbsent",
                each List.Sum(
                    Table.SelectRows(_, each Text.Upper(Text.From([Comments])) = "ATOSS ABSENCES")[Forecast Demand]
                ),
                type number
            }
        }
    ),

    #"Added ForecastDemandWithoutAtossAbsent" = Table.AddColumn(
        #"Grouped Rows",
        "ForecastDemandWithoutAtossAbsent",
        each [Forecast Demand] - [AtossAbsent],
        type number
    )
in
    #"Added ForecastDemandWithoutAtossAbsent"
